About Daily Rhythm

Daily Rhythm turns your day into a glanceable clock. See what you are doing now, what is next, prayer times, and the moon phase, while adding or changing several activities naturally in English or Arabic. The goal is to reduce planning friction and help you stay present in your day — not manage another complicated calendar.

Al-Biruni

البيروني

973–1048 · astronomy · mathematics · geography
A question about the sky
Swipe to continue
Related visual
Observation & light
An illustration that connects this scholar to the field they advanced.

Why you are seeing this

You opened the moon. Al-Biruni studied the sky, time and the Earth with mathematics and observation.

What he contributed

He wrote extensively on astronomy and devised a geometric method for estimating the Earth’s radius from observations made from a mountain.

Why it still matters

His work is a reminder that careful measurement can connect the sky above us with the world beneath our feet.

A moment from our heritage Your study session connects naturally to a story about learning and discovery.

See example phrases
"add gym at 7:30 to 8:30" Add · Gym · 7:30–8:30

"add walk 6–6:30pm and change dinner to 7:30pm" Mixed commands · Add + Change
"remove lunch" Remove · Lunch
"change work to 9 to 5" Update time · Work · 9:00–5:00
"read Qur'an from 1 to 2pm, completed Surat Al-Baqarah" Mark done · Qur'an & reading · 1–2pm · Note: "Surat Al-Baqarah"
"finished walk for 20 minutes" Mark done · Walk · Note: "Took about 20 min"
"change fajr time from 5 to 5:30" Correct prayer time · Fajr → 5:30am
"أضف الجيم الساعة ٧:٣٠ إلى ٨:٣٠" Add · Gym · 7:30–8:30
"صليت الفجر الساعة ٥:٣٠" Logged prayer · Fajr · 5:30am
"أضف السباحة من ٤ إلى ٥ ثم أضف الطبخ من ٥ إلى ٦" أمران · إضافة السباحة · إضافة الطبخ
"إعادة ضبط جدولي" إعادة ضبط · يتطلب تأكيداً قبل الحذف
